title: Grateful Dead Live at Red Rocks Amphitheatre on 1982-07-27

ai_review.summary: A stellar second set with psychedelic Terrapin and powerful Playing in the Band jam captured on a soundboard recording that suffers from hiss and mix imbalances.
ai_review.review: Fans rank this show among the Dead's all‑time greats, highlighting an exquisite Terrapin Station sandwiched between a soaring Playing in the Band jam and a heartfelt Stella Blue reprise. The performance is energetic and tightly executed, but the soundboard tape starts with noticeable hiss and uneven instrument levels that settle down as the set progresses.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is consistently praised as exceptional (≈4.8/5) while recording quality receives mixed but generally fair feedback (≈3.2/5); weighted combination yields ~4.3 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Initial hiss and tape noise, uneven mix with Jerry's guitar low and Brent's keyboards overly loud, occasional level fluctuations (e.g., Jack Straw). Sound improves later in the set.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set flows seamlessly from a psychedelic opening into a beautiful Terrapin, then into an expansive Playing jam and finishes with a Playin' reprise out of Stella Blue; overall very tight and engaging.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His solos are often buried and lower in the mix, making his guitar sound distant despite strong playing.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass is high‑energy and inventive, especially notable on The Other One.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's keyboards are vibrant and energetic, though at times they sit too high in the mix.
